(2) The scene shifts to a young boy in a white t-shirt standing in a domestic room with light walls and a storage rack filled with colorful items. He faces away from the camera toward a large white closet, preparing to perform a dance routine. (3) The boy is now wearing a light purple, ruffled dress and lying on a light wood-grained floor, crawling and posing as if acting in a play. Colorful subtitles and variety-show style captions appear on the screen to narrate his actions. (4) The boy is seated at a pink desk, performing a series of rapid hand gestures and finger hearts. Sparkle effects and graphic star overlays are added in post-production to emphasize his "cute" expressions. (5) The setting moves to a brightly lit retail clothing store with rows of garments on hangers. The boy, carrying a large white plush toy, is startled by someone jumping out from behind a rack, causing him to react with surprise. The boy holds a clear umbrella and sings into the camera while rain or moisture is visible on the ground.

Multiple layers of high-pitched laughter and energetic chatter from a child and a female voice overlap. (2) A sharp transition occurs to a more narrative, low-arousal male vocal speaking in Chinese over a gentle, major-key piano melody. This is periodically punctuated by soft "crawling" or rustling sounds. (3) Rapid "pop" and "ding" sound effects (Cartoon SFX) trigger frequently, synced with hand movements, layered over a fast-paced pop rhythm. (4) A sudden, loud vocal scream (high intensity) breaks the music, followed by a burst of group laughter with high spectral brightness. (5) The final phase features a child's live vocal singing an English pop song, exhibiting moderate outdoor reverb and a natural, warm frequency weight, with occasional natural wind floor.
